{
  "question_leaks_answer": false,
  "question_leak_note": "The question asks for the most likely root cause and supporting spec clauses without naming the fault category.",
  "evidence_supports_conclusion": "yes",
  "evidence_note": "The observed increase in UL BLER and a ~4.6× rise in estimated UL buffer together with a modest increase in UL PRB allocation indicate that traffic demand exceeds scheduled resources, consistent with sudden uplink congestion.",
  "unsupported_claims_in_conclusion": [],
  "citations": [
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 38.300",
      "section": "10.4 Measurements to Support Scheduler Operation",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Defines uplink buffer status reports and the Estimated_UL_Buffer measurement, but does not link the measurement to congestion."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "5.1.1.7.7 Error number of UL initial TBs",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "yes",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Provides the definition of the UL_BLER measurement."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "5.1.1.2.7 Mean UL PRB used for data traffic",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "yes",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Defines the UL_NPRB measurement."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 38.300",
      "section": "10.1 Basic Scheduler Operation",
      "role_claimed": "mechanism",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Describes that the scheduler uses UE buffer status to allocate resources, but does not explicitly state that insufficient allocation leads to buffer backlog (congestion)."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 38.300",
      "section": "15.5.1.1 General",
      "role_claimed": "mechanism",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Mentions load balancing for congested cells, supporting the notion of congestion as a fault class, but does not directly tie the KPI pattern to congestion."
    }
  ],
  "has_adequate_mechanism_citation": false,
  "acceptable_conclusions_reasonable": true,
  "uncertainty_honest_and_complete": true,
  "uncertainty_missing": [
    "Explicit mechanism citation linking uplink buffer growth and limited PRB allocation to congestion (e.g., a clause in TS 38.321 or a more detailed part of TS 38.300)."
  ],
  "verdict": "valid_with_changes",
  "required_changes": [
    "Add a citation to a specification clause that explicitly describes the relationship between uplink buffer backlog, PRB allocation limits, and congestion (e.g., 3GPP TS 38.321 MAC scheduling behavior or a more detailed part of TS 38.300).",
    "Clarify that the current citations only define measurements and give a high‑level scheduler description, and therefore do not fully explain the observed BLER increase."
  ],
  "confidence": 0.78
}
